name: NT
method: Read-only public Kaggle About and Competitions pages loaded in the app's built-in browser on 2026-10-30 (profile page, then the competitions page after a five-second pause; no refreshes, no block or captcha seen). Page text was read with get_page_text. Per-row medals, ranks, team counts and displayed team accounts were read from each row's own labels in the page (read with the browser's script tool); screenshots of the profile confirmed the aggregate three-silver, two-bronze medal panel, which matches the row labels. The portrait image address was read from the visible own-profile avatar element. The browser held a signed-in session (a Follow/Unfollow control showed), but only public profile content was used. No older draft file existed for this person, so nothing from a prior draft was carried over.

portrait.note: NT's own Kaggle profile picture is a cartoon yellow bird with black eyebrows, half-lidded eyes and an ochre beak; he chose it himself, so it is his own individual picture (a drawn character, not a photograph). The portrait file previously attached to his record, nt-mitubant-avatar-v2.webp (1200 by 900), is a generated scene of that bird in engineering gear, not his own picture, so it is not used as the portrait; the older nt-mitubant-avatar-v1.webp is a wrong-identity image already marked superseded. The new file is the current own-profile avatar (400 by 400, avatar address stamped 2026-07-19) converted to webp from a temporary download, with no crop, edit or generation. Visually checked against the profile page: same bird.

facts.text: NT, who uses the Kaggle handle mitubant, joined Kaggle in November 2018 and is a Competitions Expert with three silver and two bronze competition medals, ranked 1,723rd of 225,021.

The entry shows five accounts: nahman, evilpsycho42, mitubant, calibrator and russcore; it is a team medal, not NT's solo result.
